    CASE WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
    CASE WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_sensitivity_count,
    (CASE WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN envsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END +
     CASE WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) / 11.0 AS erf
  FROM sensitivitydata
),
artifact_env AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry AS ArtRegistry, a.artname AS ArtName, a.artageyears,
         e.tempc, e.relhumidity
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN conditionassessments ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
  JOIN showcases s ON ca.showcaserefexamined = s.showcasereg
  JOIN environmentalreadingscore e ON e.showcaseref = s.showcasereg
)
SELECT ae.ArtRegistry, ae.ArtName,
       ae.tempc AS current_temp,
       ae.relhumidity AS current_humidity,
       sc2.high_sensitivity_count AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN ROUND(CAST((ae.artageyears * sc2.erf * POWER(CAST(ae.relhumidity - 50 AS numeric), 2) * CAST(ae.tempc AS numeric)) / 100000 AS numeric), 4) > 5 AND sc2.high_sensitivity_count >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM artifact_env ae
JOIN sensitivity_calc sc2 ON ae.ArtRegistry = sc2.artref;
